entry_stop: min(impulse low,pullback lows) long; max(impulse high,pullback highs) short; invalid side entry gap is rejected by shared engine
feature_authority: All OHLC features from contiguous closed prefix only; volume ignored because units unbound; no future outcome field read.
grammar: On a complete 30m bar native Supertrend direction is established; flips cancel pending setup and cannot emit.
An aligned close beyond the previous candle high/low arms a new structural impulse. Record impulse origin low/high.
A later countertrend close relative to previous close, still on valid side of native line and impulse origin, records a pullback.
A later close beyond the first pullback candle high/low confirms continuation. Enter only next UTC 30m open.
Cancel pending setup on native direction reversal, completed close at/beyond impulse origin, absent/noncontiguous segment, or >16 bars since impulse.
Distinct subsequent impulses can rearm in the same trend; no episode quota.

indicator.atr_method: Wilder seeded with first 10 contiguous true ranges
indicator.initial_direction: close>=HL2 long else short at first complete ATR
indicator.name: native_supertrend
indicator.parameter_source: backend/research/rebuild/trend_policy_batch_v1.py::TrendPolicyConfig numerical defaults only; no legacy trade/result authority

lifecycle.failure_exit: opposite native direction or close at/beyond impulse origin -> next bar open
lifecycle.native_line_trail: Completed-bar line only, applied from next bar; never loosen stop.

parent_control: Exact saved 15m EMA-labelled donor is diagnostic ancestry only; root must preserve exact 30m control identity and avoid legacy 1h scoreboard.
timeframe_choice: 30m architecture resolves impulse/pullback/reclaim phases with 8h intraday horizon; engineering choice frozen before any child economics, no 15m/30m candidate competition.
